description:
The Rambo Venom RS is Rambo's most aggressive machine yet — a full-power electric dirt bike built for riders who want moto-level performance without giving up control. This isn't a fat-tire cruiser; it's a purpose-built off-road machine engineered to launch hard, corner with confidence, and keep charging long after lesser bikes fold.
At the heart of the Venom RS is an Advanced LPMSM motor rated at 4000W continuous with a 10,000W peak output, delivering 390 N·m of instant torque for explosive acceleration out of corners and up steep grades. Power comes from a removable 72V/35Ah lithium-ion battery pack, giving you up to 75 miles of range and a top speed of 38 mph — plenty to open up trails, tracks, and backcountry terrain.
The forged 6061-T6 aluminum frame keeps the Venom RS light without sacrificing strength, while the FastAce front fork (200mm of travel) and FastAce rear shock soak up roots, rocks, and braking bumps so you stay planted at speed. When it's time to slow down, 203mm hydraulic disc brakes front and rear bring serious stopping power in any condition.
Built for riders who demand real performance from their electric ride, the Rambo Venom RS delivers the torque, range, and control to take on any terrain — no gas, no noise, no limits.
